title: Correct magnitude for part (1)
description: Essential: The answer must state the magnitude of the surface force as $(m_1 + m_2)g_0$.

title: Correct direction for part (1)
description: Essential: The answer must state the direction of the surface force is vertically upward (or normal to the surface).

title: Forces on ascent vehicle
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the ascent vehicle, identifying the thrust force components relative to the incline.

title: Component resolution
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve gravitational and thrust forces into components parallel and perpendicular to the inclined surface.

title: Correct final expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be $m_1\sqrt{g_0^2 + a^2 + 2g_0 a \cos\theta}$ or its equivalent.

title: Vector combination
description: Important: The solution must correctly combine the perpendicular and parallel thrust components using the Pythagorean theorem to find the magnitude.

title: Neglects fuel mass
description: Optional: The solution should note that the mass of ejected fuel is negligible, so $m_1$ is constant.

title: Sign error in components
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the component of gravity along the incline or the normal direction has an incorrect sign relative to the thrust.

title: Confuses combined mass
description: Pitfall: Penalize if part (2) incorrectly uses the total mass $(m_1+m_2)$ instead of just the ascent vehicle mass $m_1$.
